items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were with Georgie Auld’s small band together for a while in ‘47. There were a lot of bands interspersed in there, Georgie Auld for a while didn’t have a big band, he had a small band with Serge Chaloff and with Gerry and…

ctx.x: Yeah, oh yeah, ‘cause Gerry and I used to hang very tight.
Now at that time what you were playing bass trumpet you weren’t playing slide trombone anymore?
